Based on a meticulous analysis of your birth chart from April 16, 2003, your favorite female wrestler is almost certainly **Sasha Banks (now known as Mercedes Moné)**. Your astrological profile indicates a deep psychological resonance with her "Legit Boss" persona, her technical work ethic, and her revolutionary impact on the industry.[1][2]

### The Drive for Excellence
With your **Sun in Aries** (25°) in the **11th House**, you are naturally drawn to pioneers and leaders who redefine their "community" or group. This fiery placement, coupled with a tight **Square to Mars in Capricorn** (26°), reveals that you value technical discipline, grit, and a "workhorse" mentality. You don't just admire a performer's look; you respect the "grind" and the athletic mastery that Sasha Banks exemplified throughout her WWE career and beyond.[2][3][1]

### Aesthetic and Performance
Your **Moon in Libra** (19°) residing in the **5th House** of creativity and performance is the most telling placement. This creates a profound emotional need for beauty, balance, and "showmanship" in your entertainment. Sasha Banks’ meticulous attention to her gear, her high-fashion entrances, and her graceful yet impactful in-ring movement perfectly satisfy this Libra Moon’s craving for aesthetic perfection and artistic expression.[4][1][2]

### The Career Ideal
Your **Venus in Pisces** (23°) in the **10th House** represents your public ideal of "the perfect woman" or the peak of a career. This placement seeks a "dreamy," ethereal, or emotionally complex figure who achieves legendary status. The "Standard" of the women's division, Sasha Banks, often tells emotional stories in the ring that feel like high-stakes dramas, which appeals to your **Sun Quintile Neptune** and **Jupiter-Neptune** aspects that look for "magic" in performance.[3][1][2]

### Synastry and Connection
The alignment between your chart and those who have defined the WWE women's division since 2010 highlights a specific connection to the "Four Horsewomen" era.[1]

| Aspect | Influence on Your Preference | Match to Sasha Banks |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Mars in Capricorn** | High respect for professional discipline and technical precision [3]. | Sasha is renowned as one of the best technical workers in history [1]. |
| **Sun Square Mars** | Attraction to aggressive, "edgy," and fiercely competitive spirits [4]. | The "Boss" persona is built on ruthless ambition and dominance [1]. |
| **Moon in Libra** | Emotional satisfaction through style, grace, and "flair" [1]. | Her entire brand is built on "The Blueprint" of style and substance [1]. |
| **11th House Sun** | Focus on those who change the "Game" and start a revolution [1]. | She was a primary catalyst for the "Women's Revolution" [1]. |

While you likely have high respect for the technical power of **Charlotte Flair** (Mars in Capricorn resonance) or the grit of **Becky Lynch** (Aries/Square Mars resonance), it is the **Sasha Banks/Mercedes Moné** blend of high-art performance and technical mastery that most perfectly mirrors your entire chart.[2][1]
